name: council-review
description: Run three independent read-only reviews, then have oracle synthesize the findings.

parallel.label: Correctness review
parallel.task: Review {task} for correctness, regressions, and missing edge cases. Do not edit files.

parallel.label: Test review
parallel.task: Review {task} with emphasis on test coverage, verification evidence, and failure modes. Do not edit files.

parallel.label: Scope review
parallel.task: Review {task} for unnecessary complexity, scope drift, and maintainability risks. Do not edit files.

chain.label: Council synthesis
